Профили хранятся отдельно от агентов. На: Profiles are stored separately from agents. Model files and capabilities are checked independently.
В карточке агента выберите способ запуск: In an agent card, choose how to launch it (Desktop, terminal, etc.) and click “Launch agent”. “Install ↗” opens the official releases; after installing, click “Rediscover agents”.
llama-swap — сервер, к которому подключа: llama-swap is the server agents connect to (Qwen Code, Hermes and others). It listens on a single port and starts llama-server from llama.cpp with the requested model on demand. Station generates its configuration from model profiles, so the server usually starts automatically when a model is loaded.
Переключать видеокарты между WDDM и TCC: Only an administrator can switch GPUs between WDDM and TCC. The Station installer sets up a switching service that performs only this operation, without an elevation prompt. Without the service, Windows asks for administrator rights once for each switch.
